title: test(spec): the second data/ file group's test titles state each cited decision in words instead of a tracker number (stage 16)
body:
Part of #20749
Clause-②: no

Stage 16 of this card: the next area of class (e), the test strings shipped under `packages/spec/src`, as ruled in `5902360492` on #20513. This stage takes the second name-ordered file group directly under `packages/spec/src/data/`: the 20 test files from `default-value-shape.test.ts` to `filter-comparand-shape.test.ts`. They carried 94 messages and 100 tracker ids, citing 59 records plus one decision-batch number. Every one of those ids now either states what its record decided, in words (form D), or is dropped where the title already says it. Text only: no assertion, identifier, test count or code comment changes.

## Census at the base (`a3ffc4512d`)

Instruments: `census10.cjs` (md5 `9d08602ab972b4b8643c90d64d40fa41`), `census.cjs` (md5 `6e42a45a926d375013c32d62f16a296e`), `census-wide.cjs` (md5 `c98410a19529c439adb0afbfb00026a2`) and `dirtable.cjs` (md5 `dda605c54745b4a60cc14c9a686e4eff`). They are byte-identical to the copies stages 10 to 15 used. A literal counts as a test title when its folded message is argument 0 of a `describe` / `it` / `test` call, `.each` / `.skip` / `.only` chains included. Everything else is an "other" string.

Both instruments read **1231 messages / 1304 ids in 262 files**, the seat's reading at `a3ffc4512d` (stage 15's head).

## How the area was chosen

`data/` has no subdirectory to split by, so its stages take name-ordered file groups near the ~100-id bound. Stage 15's re-cut named this group at exactly 100, and this census reads 100, so the rule needed no re-cut.

**Named for the next stages** (re-cut from the head census, 1137 / 1204; `data/` 280 / 299 left, the same cut stage 15 named):
- `data/` in three more stages, name-ordered:
  1. `filter-comparand-type.test.ts` to `filter-view-operator-parity.test.ts`: 20 files, 95 messages / 99 ids;
  2. `filter.test.ts` to `object.test.ts`: 17 files, 103 / 114. `object.test.ts` alone carries 42, so no cut lands nearer the bound;
  3. `query-transport.test.ts` to `validation.test.ts` (11 files, 34 / 34) with `data/driver/` (7 files, 48 / 52): 86 ids.
- `ui/` 416, about four stages. `api/` 201, two. `system/` 165, two. The files directly in `src/`, 120, one.
- The three docblock needles (`ai/build-progress.test.ts:236`, `:237`, `contracts/approval-service.test.ts:274`), one stage with their docblocks.

## What each id became

31 literals (36 ids) now state a decision in words. 2 literals (2 ids) get their subject back in words where the number stood in for it. 61 literals (62 ids) drop a number the title already explains.

Every cited record was read with its comments through REST: 56 answer 200, the four `objectui` records among them. #8656, #12868 and #16867 answer 404, and their decisions were read from what landed: `94f7ef8` (a `Field.time` builder that produces the literal shape an author could already write), `c459da6bc` (the form-view option shape is the object-field option shape minus `default`) and `0ee32ed` (the flat `notNull` spellings prescribe `storage.notNull`, not `required`), each with its CHANGELOG entry.

| record(s) | literal (under `data/`) | now reads |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #4560 | `default-value-tokens.test.ts:15` | "defaultValue runtime tokens — one vocabulary the engine and the DDL both read". The token set moved to one source that the engine's default stamping and the SQL driver's column defaults both read, so a runtime token is never written as a literal column DEFAULT. |
| #14477 (2) | `document.test.ts:238`, `:255` | "… a retiredKey() tombstone, since nothing ever read it (ADR-0049)". The pair had no reader and no roadmap, so it retired with the other deadline families. |

- Each of these titles already states the decision it pins: for example "deleteBehavior: set_null on master_detail is a parse-time rejection" for #9689, "the list-comparand shape door runs inside parseFilterAST" for #5869 and #9228, or "refuses `precision` at EVERY value, in range or not: the key was removed, not re-bounded" for #19992.
- **`driver-nosql.test.ts:375`** now reads "NoSQLQueryOptions.timeout carries its unit", the same text stage 14 gave `ai/conversation.test.ts`, so the two read alike.
- **`filter-boolean-comparand-declared-type.test.ts`:** its six describes and five `it`s carried the two records as a file-wide tag. The verdict's describe now states the decision (above). The others name the contract part they pin (the accepted spellings, the judged fields, the refusal message, the fixture, the case table), and their child titles state what each part does. The file's header comment still names both records; comments are not touched here.
- **The `(the #9689 class)` tails** on three idempotency titles go: each title already says "parse(parse(x)) is byte-identical" or "re-parses cleanly", which is what that class names.

## Text-only proof

Stage 10's scratch tool (`textonly10.cjs`, md5 `d5e4801dbb4329ab1984da91e92fc47c`) compares base and head file by file on three legs:
1. **Skeleton:** the full AST, with string pieces masked. It must be identical.
2. **Comments:** every comment, byte-equal.
3. **Strings:** each changed string leaf must sit in a test-call title position or on a declared line, must carry a tracker id before, and must carry no `#` plus digits after. The declared lines are `external-lookup-retirement.test.ts:89` and `:130`, `field-default-value.test.ts:98`, `:116` and `:123`, and `filter-array-declaration.test.ts:142`.

- **Result:** 20 of 20 files SAME on all three legs, with the per-file counts predicted in writing before the run.
- **Totals:** 94 changed literals, 88 titles and 6 declared. The diff's `+` and `-` lines are exactly the 94 planned lines, and every file keeps its line count.
- **Controls (10 of 10 as predicted, on scratch copies, each anchor hit once):** identifier rename DIFF; numeric literal DIFF; comment edit COMMENT DIFF; a non-title string given an id VIOLATION; a rewritten title given a new id VIOLATION; a title that was id-free at base edited VIOLATION; one title reverted to base SAME; a declared string given a new id VIOLATION; an undeclared `expect` message changed VIOLATION; a title re-split into a `+` chain DIFF.

**Test counts:** the 20 files were run at the base, in a separate base worktree, and at the head, with `--project local --project repo`. Both sides read 766 tests (765 passed, 1 todo), with the same count and status sequence per file in 20 of 20. 503 full test names change, and each equals the base name with the planned replacements applied (0 mismatches). No full name repeats on either side.

## `main` since the base

Re-fetched just before this PR opened, `origin/main` was six commits past the base (`088428fb42`). None of them touches any of the 20 files, so `main` was not merged. Two of them touch `packages/spec` source (`ui/report.form.ts` and `data/object.zod.ts`); this diff changes only test-title text, so it cannot combine with them into a joint failure, and the merge queue re-runs the suite on the merged generation.

## Acceptance notes

- **No needle in this group.** Every id was a title or a declared string; no expected value of an assertion over a source docblock was found. The three known needles are untouched.
- **Same-id test titles in this card's later stages** go with those stages: 46 lines in `packages/spec/src` (14 in later `data/` groups, 9 in `system/`, 23 in `ui/`). Among them, `ui/view.test.ts:1893` ("leaves the malformed-declaration refusals (#8321/#12174) reading exactly as before") and `ui/action-param-default-value.test.ts:154` (`#16077 carries the rename …`) are near-twins of titles rewritten here.
- **Same-id test titles in other packages** are their lanes' test-string shares. A search of `describe` / `it` / `test` lines outside `packages/spec` finds 111 lines in 15 packages citing ids this PR handled: `objectql` 47 (22 files), `driver-sql` 18 (13), `rest` 15 (12), `driver-mongodb` 6 (3), `lint` 5 (4), `plugin-security` 5 (2), `cli` 3 (2), `core` 2, `driver-memory` 2, `metadata-protocol` 2, `service-analytics` 2, and one each in `driver-turso`, `plugin-audit`, `qa/dogfood` and `service-automation`.
